dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SONARR_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thespad"

# set environment variables
ENV XDG_CONFIG_HOME="/config/xdg" \
  SONARR_BRANCH="develop" \
  SONARR_CHANNEL="v5-nightly" \
  COMPlus_EnableDiagnostics=0 \
  TMPDIR=/run/sonarr-temp

RUN \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    icu-libs \
    krb5-libs \
    sqlite-libs \
    xmlstarlet && \
  echo "**** install sonarr ****" && \
  mkdir -p /app/sonarr/bin && \
  if [ -z ${SONARR_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    SONARR_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET http://services.sonarr.tv/v1/releases \
    | jq -r "first(.[] | select(.releaseChannel==\"${SONARR_CHANNEL}\") | .version)"); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/sonarr.tar.gz -L \
    "https://services.sonarr.tv/v1/update/${SONARR_BRANCH}/download?version=${SONARR_VERSION}&os=linuxmusl&runtime=netcore&arch=x64" && \
  tar xzf \
    /tmp/sonarr.tar.gz -C \
    /app/sonarr/bin --strip-components=1 && \
  echo -e "UpdateMethod=docker\nBranch=${SONARR_BRANCH}\nPackageVersion=${VERSION:-LocalBuild}\nPackageAuthor=[linuxserver.io](https://linuxserver.io)" > /app/sonarr/package_info && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /app/sonarr/bin/Sonarr.Update \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8989

VOLUME /config

units.name: init-sonarr-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /run/sonarr-temp

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config \
        /run/sonarr-temp
fi

units.name: svc-sonarr
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

export TERM=DUMB

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            cd /app/sonarr/bin s6-setuidgid abc /app/sonarr/bin/Sonarr \
            -nobrowser -data=/config
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
            cd /app/sonarr/bin /app/sonarr/bin/Sonarr \
            -nobrowser -data=/config
fi

notes.upstream:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 9a41dfc129d5bbf8f3950f871623b46eea4f914e -->

## What's Changed
### Changes
* Translations update from Servarr Weblate by @ServarrAdmin in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9238
* Optimize: reduce duplicate requests on load and memoize command lookups by @IonBazan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9167
* Fix auto tags on series refresh and speed up import list sync by @IonBazan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9083
* Optimize series and download cache updates by @IonBazan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9166
* Replace interactive search with cards instead of table by @markus101 in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9231
* New: Mark advanced settings and make fewer settings advanced by @markus101 in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9237
* Improve rejection message for import failures due to permissions by @mynameisbogdan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9240
* Use correct branding for external series links by @stevietv in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9241
* Fixed: Interactive search failing when a release couldn't be processed by @markus101 in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9242
* Add context to System page action buttons by @coopa11y in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9243
* Add folder paths to Manual Import buttons by @coopa11y in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9244
* TVRage ID in Kodi episode guide by @markus101 in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9245
* Fix HDB multi-season searches by @mynameisbogdan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9246
* Fixed: Series details navigation to use filters and sorting from index by @mynameisbogdan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9247
* Fix actions spacing for override and grab modal by @mynameisbogdan in https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/9249


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/compare/v5.0.0.2870...v5.0.0.2907
